NONE: › a small smooth round stone, especially one found on a beach or in a river
（尤指沙灘或河流中的）卵石，礫石

example: This part of the coast has pebble beaches.
海岸的這一部分有幾處礫石海灘。

NONE: › a substance that is spread on the outside walls of a building, consisting of cement with many small stones mixed into it
小卵石灰漿，灰泥小石子（在灰泥中混入許多小石子，一種用於塗抹外牆的材料）

example: The pebbledash on the house was starting to come loose and flake off in small patches.
房子的灰泥礫石外牆開始鬆動了，有幾處小塊地方掉了下來。
a row of suburban pebbledash houses
郊外一排灰泥礫石外牆的房屋
